# NEXUS: AI-Powered Criminal Network Analysis Dashboard Frontend

Build a law-enforcement intelligence dashboard frontend named **NEXUS**, inspired by professional tactical intelligence platforms (e.g. Palantir Gotham, Analyst's Notebook, Maltego). The interface will feature high-density data displays, intelligence classification markings, dark/light tactical styling, interactive network analysis graph visualization, multi-entity dossiers, evidence ingestion vaults, and case timelines.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The project will be initialized in `C:\Users\Nityam Jaiswal\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\nexus`. Once created, you can open this directory as your active workspace in your editor.

> [!NOTE]
> All mock data is pre-populated with realistic, interconnected criminal investigation scenarios (e.g. Operation "Ghost Syndicate", international money laundering, shell companies, burner phone intercepts, and high-value targets) so every page feels live and functional out of the box.

## Proposed Architecture & Design

### Tactical Visual Design System
- **Theme**: Dark Tactical Intelligence (default) + Clean Analytical Light Mode, switchable via Top Nav and Settings.
- **Palette**: Deep slate/zinc backdrop (`#090d16` / `#0f172a`), emerald/cyan telemetry indicators, amber warning highlights, crimson critical alerts, and subtle border grids.
- **Typography & Details**: High-contrast typography with monospace serial IDs, timestamps, clearance badges (`TOP SECRET // SI // NOFORN`), threat score meters, and status pills.
- **Motion**: Subtle, purposeful state transitions; zero distracting or excessive animations.

---

## Proposed Changes

### Project Initialization & Core Configuration
- Scaffold Vite + React + TypeScript in `C:\Users\Nityam Jaiswal\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\nexus`.
- Install dependencies: `react-router-dom`, `lucide-react`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `canvas-confetti` (for verification/actions if needed), and Tailwind CSS toolchain.
- Configure Tailwind CSS with custom intelligence color tokens, glowing status indicators, and tactical typography.
